name: Podcast Show Notes Creator
description: Drop in your transcript or outline and get SEO-optimized show notes, timestamps, key quotes, and social captions — all done.
seoDescription: Drop in your transcript or outline and get SEO-optimized show notes, timestamps, key quotes, and social captions — done in minutes, not hours.
long_description: Writing show notes feels like a chore so most podcasters either skip them or write something generic. That's a mistake — good show notes are free SEO and the thing that convinces new listeners to press play. This skill turns your transcript, outline, or rough notes into complete show notes: episode summary, timestamped chapters, key quotes, guest bio, resource list, and 3 platform-specific social captions. Takes 2 minutes instead of 45.
author: CreatorSkills
